title: A garden entrance
passage:
A. A diagonal board rests on a concrete block and reaches up to the post beside the open gate.
B. A diagonal board reaches down from the post onto the gravel path.
C. A diagonal board rests on a concrete block and stretches across the entrance.
D. A concrete block sits in the opening and holds the gate ajar.
passageZh:
A. 一根斜放的木板一端靠在混凝土塊上，另一端往上延伸到敞開的大門旁的柱子。
B. 一根斜放的木板從柱子往下延伸到碎石步道上。
C. 一根斜放的木板靠在混凝土塊上，橫跨入口。
D. 一塊混凝土放在入口中間，使門保持開著。
